Aggregate environmental exposure over a preceding time window

Source: R/functional_environment.R
pheno_environment_window.Rd

Aggregate environmental exposure over a preceding time window

Usage

pheno_environment_window(
  weather,
  time,
  variables,
  window = 7,
  by = NULL,
  functions = c("mean", "sum", "max")
)

Arguments

weather

Environmental data frame.

time

Time column.

variables

Numeric variables to summarize.

window

Width of the preceding window in time units.

by

Optional grouping columns.

functions

Named summary functions among mean, sum, max, min.

Value

Data frame with rolling environmental summaries.

Examples

w <- pheno_data("weather_series")
pheno_environment_window(w,"day",c("tmean","rain"),window=7)
